fields.summary_ko.0: Applied Materials (AMAT) outperformed the S&P 500 for four consecutive years with a 328% gain, but net profit grew only 39% over the same period, indicating share price appreciation significantly outpaced earnings growth.
fields.summary_ko.1: Only 23 of 485 S&P 500 companies achieved four consecutive years of outperformance, double the 13 expected by pure chance, suggesting a combination of operational performance and luck.
